associations.rationale: The formal type exposes a tensor-product type for a right and a left module, but not its construction as a free abelian group modulo the displayed relations.
The equality directly states additivity of the pure tensor operation in its right-module argument.
The equality directly states the balancing relation between the right action on the first factor and the left action on the second factor.
This declaration constructs pure tensors in the tensor-product type but does not itself state additivity or the balancing quotient relation.
The equality directly states additivity of the pure tensor operation in its left-module argument.
